verdict.rationale: Paddle ships an official, hosted remote MCP server (sandbox and live endpoints) with OAuth/API-key auth, documented tool surface (search/execute), plus a separate docs MCP server and agent-skills discovery — all independently confirmed live via probes (401+OAuth challenge at mcp.paddle.com, working skills index, working paddle-mcp docs page), not just vendor claims. Missing for 10: independent hands-on/community testimony of using the MCP server in a real agent workflow beyond vendor docs and automated probes.
